# Command-line interface

`myelin` runs every engine in CI or on a workstation, uploads results, asks for gate decisions and collects cloud inventories. Install it from the package supplied with your subscription (`MYELIN_CLI_PACKAGE`) or use the `myelin-cli` container image.

| Environment | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `MYELIN_SERVER` | Platform URL for uploads and gate checks |
| `MYELIN_API_KEY` | Integration API key |
| `MYELIN_CA_FILE` | Extra CA certificate for a private platform |
| `MYELIN_OFFLINE=1` | Never contact the internet (air-gapped) |

## `myelin scan`



| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `path` | Default: `.`. |
| `--image` | scan a container image (requires trivy or grype on PATH) |
| `--repo` |  |
| `--engines` |  |
| `--policy` |  |
| `--server` |  |
| `--sarif` |  |
| `--sbom` |  |
| `--json` |  |
| `--fail-on` | (block · warn · never) Default: `block`. |
| `--report` | write a self-contained HTML repository assessment |
| `--require` | comma-separated domains that must complete |
| `--builtin-only` | skip third-party scanners even if installed |

```text
usage: myelin scan [-h] [--image IMAGE] [--repo REPO] [--engines ENGINES]
                   [--policy POLICY] [--server SERVER] [--sarif SARIF]
                   [--sbom SBOM] [--json JSON] [--fail-on {block,warn,never}]
                   [--report REPORT] [--require REQUIRE] [--builtin-only]
                   [path]
```

## `myelin dast`

test a running web API (read-only by default)

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--target` | base URL of the API, e.g. https://api.example.com |
| `--openapi` | OpenAPI/Swagger spec (file or URL) — enables per-operation authentication checks |
| `--header` | extra request header 'Name: value' (repeatable); prefer MYELIN_DAST_AUTH for tokens |
| `--name` | asset name shown in the console (default: host name) |
| `--criticality` | (low · medium · high · critical) Default: `medium`. |
| `--max-requests` | Default: `300`. |
| `--delay` | Default: `0.2`. |
| `--insecure` | continue when the TLS certificate is untrusted (still reported) |
| `--zap` | also run OWASP ZAP baseline (passive) in Docker |
| `--crawl` | discover pages, forms, scripts and query parameters (read-only GET requests) |
| `--active` | active checks (XSS, SQL injection, open redirect, path traversal, template injection); with --zap also ZAP's active scan. Sends attack payloads: needs --authorized |
| `--authorized` | confirm written authorisation for --active |
| `--identities` | YAML/JSON with 2+ test users → cross-user (BOLA), role (BFLA) and data-exposure tests |
| `--report` | write a self-contained HTML assessment report |
| `--customer` | name printed on the report |
| `--assessor` |  |
| `--policy` |  |
| `--server` |  |
| `--sarif` |  |
| `--json` |  |
| `--fail-on` | (block · warn · never) Default: `block`. |

```text
usage: myelin dast [-h] --target TARGET [--openapi OPENAPI] [--header HEADER]
                   [--name NAME] [--criticality {low,medium,high,critical}]
                   [--max-requests MAX_REQUESTS] [--delay DELAY] [--insecure]
                   [--zap] [--crawl] [--active] [--authorized]
                   [--identities IDENTITIES] [--report REPORT]
                   [--customer CUSTOMER] [--assessor ASSESSOR]
                   [--policy POLICY] [--server SERVER] [--sarif SARIF]
                   [--json JSON] [--fail-on {block,warn,never}]
```

## `myelin vex`

apply CycloneDX VEX or CSAF 2.0 evidence to saved scan results

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--results` | scan JSON produced by myelin scan --json |
| `--document` | VEX/CSAF JSON file; repeat to merge sources |
| `--policy` | policy file to re-evaluate after evidence ingestion |
| `--output` | output JSON (defaults to updating --results) |

```text
usage: myelin vex [-h] --results RESULTS --document DOCUMENT [--policy POLICY]
                  [--output OUTPUT]
```

## `myelin gate`

block a deployment: evaluate --results, or ask the platform about --repo/--commit

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--results` |  |
| `--policy` |  |
| `--repo` |  |
| `--commit` |  |
| `--environment` | target environment, recorded in the audit trail |
| `--server` |  |
| `--fail-on` | (block · warn) Default: `block`. |
| `--allow-unscanned` | do not fail when the commit was never scanned |
| `--scope` | new: only findings this commit introduced can block (all · new) Default: `all`. |
<!-- coderabbit-ai-generated:v1 -->

<!-- coderabbit-ai-generated-section:v1:64cb6083288e0736bde11075390dadebb6aecadd3bd2f751bb5d3c8a46ecf11e -->

| `--require` | comma-separated domains that must complete (missing or partial → block) |

<!-- /coderabbit-ai-generated:v1 -->

```text
usage: myelin gate [-h] [--results RESULTS] [--policy POLICY] [--repo REPO]
                   [--commit COMMIT] [--environment ENVIRONMENT]
                   [--server SERVER] [--fail-on {block,warn}]
                   [--allow-unscanned] [--scope {all,new}] [--require REQUIRE]
```

|---|---|
| `file` |  |
| `--repo` |  |

| `--policy` |  |

```text

```

## `myelin cloud`

cloud and Kubernetes posture (CSPM / KSPM / CIEM): collect read-only or load an inventory

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | (scan · collect) |
| `--provider` | (azure · aws · gcp · kubernetes) |
| `--inventory` | NERvvE inventory, Azure Resource Graph JSON, Cloud Asset export or kubectl -o json List |
| `--account` | account / subscription / project / cluster label |
| `--subscriptions` | Azure: comma-separated subscription IDs |
| `--regions` | AWS: comma-separated regions (default us-east-1) |
| `--parent` | Google Cloud: projects/<id>, folders/<id> or organizations/<id> |
| `--server-url` | Kubernetes: API server URL |
| `--credential-file` | credential JSON (or set MYELIN_CLOUD_CREDENTIAL); AWS uses the boto3 chain when omitted |
| `--out` | write the normalised inventory (for air-gapped upload) |
| `--json` |  |
| `--server` |  |
| `--upload` | upload the inventory to MYELIN_SERVER |
| `--fail-on` | (critical · high · medium · never) Default: `never`. |

```text
usage: myelin cloud [-h] [--provider {azure,aws,gcp,kubernetes}]
                    [--inventory INVENTORY] [--account ACCOUNT]
                    [--subscriptions SUBSCRIPTIONS] [--regions REGIONS]
                    [--parent PARENT] [--server-url SERVER_URL]
                    [--credential-file CREDENTIAL_FILE] [--out OUT]
                    [--json JSON] [--server SERVER] [--upload]
                    [--fail-on {critical,high,medium,never}]
                    {scan,collect}
```
